citations.authors: Whittaker JL, Ellis R, Hodges PW, et al.
citations.title: Imaging with ultrasound in physical therapy: What is the PT's scope of practice? A competency-based educational model and training recommendations
citations.what_it_says: International expert consensus defining four categories of PT ultrasound use and a competency-based training model placing imaging within PT scope of practice.

citations.authors: Smith M, Innes S, Wildman S, Baker D
citations.title: A proposed framework for point of care musculoskeletal ultrasound and ultrasound image-guided interventions by physiotherapists: scope of practice, education and governance
citations.what_it_says: Proposes a three-pillar framework (scope, education/competency, governance) for physiotherapist-performed POCUS.

citations.authors: Roy JS, Braen C, Leblond J, et al.
citations.title: Diagnostic accuracy of ultrasonography, MRI and MR arthrography in the characterisation of rotator cuff disorders: a systematic review and meta-analysis
citations.what_it_says: Meta-analysis: ultrasound has diagnostic accuracy comparable to MRI for full- and partial-thickness rotator cuff tears.

citations.authors: Markowski AM, Watkins MK, Maitland ME, et al.
citations.title: Exploring the integration of diagnostic musculoskeletal ultrasound imaging into clinical practice by physical therapists
citations.what_it_says: Study of RMSK-certified US PTs (16 of all 23 then certified) who performed 1,110 MSK-US exams over 110 weeks, using imaging on ~28% of caseload.

citations.authors: Manske R, Podoll K, Markowski A, et al.
citations.title: Physical Therapists Use of Diagnostic Ultrasound Imaging in Clinical Practice: A Review of Case Reports
citations.journal: International Journal of Sports Physical Therapy
citations.what_it_says: Review of 42 published case reports documenting PTs using diagnostic ultrasound to identify serious pathology and guide decisions.

citations.authors: Duijn EAHD, Pouliart N, Verhagen AP, et al.
citations.title: Diagnostic ultrasound in patients with shoulder pain: An inter-examiner agreement and reliability study among Dutch physical therapists
citations.what_it_says: PTs performing shoulder ultrasound showed moderate-to-substantial inter-examiner agreement for rotator cuff tears and tendinopathy.

citations.authors: Thoomes-de Graaf M, Scholten-Peeters GGM, Duijn E, et al.
citations.title: Inter-professional agreement of ultrasound-based diagnoses in patients with shoulder pain between physical therapists and radiologists in the Netherlands
citations.what_it_says: Substantial agreement (kappa 0.63) between PTs and radiologists for full-thickness rotator cuff tear detection on ultrasound.

citations.authors: Whittaker JL, Teyhen DS, Elliott JM, et al.
citations.title: Rehabilitative ultrasound imaging: understanding the technology and its applications
citations.journal: Journal of Orthopaedic & Sports Physical Therapy
citations.what_it_says: Foundational JOSPT paper defining rehabilitative ultrasound imaging (RUSI) and its applications in PT practice.

citations.authors: Teyhen DS, Miltenberger CE, Deiters HM, et al.
citations.title: The use of ultrasound imaging of the abdominal drawing-in maneuver in subjects with low back pain
citations.journal: Journal of Orthopaedic & Sports Physical Therapy
citations.what_it_says: RCT: ultrasound imaging reliably measures lateral abdominal muscle activation (intrarater reliability >0.93) and biofeedback aids the drawing-in maneuver.

citations.authors: Hides JA, Richardson CA, Jull GA
citations.title: Multifidus muscle recovery is not automatic after resolution of acute, first-episode low back pain
citations.what_it_says: Landmark ultrasound-imaging-based trial: lumbar multifidus atrophy persists after acute LBP resolves unless targeted exercise is provided.

citations.authors: Potter CL, Cairns MC, Stokes M
citations.title: Use of ultrasound imaging by physiotherapists: a pilot study to survey use, skills and training
citations.what_it_says: UK survey documenting physiotherapist ultrasound use and identifying substantial unmet training and competency needs.

citations.title: Musculoskeletal ultrasound imaging - An exploration of physiotherapists' interests and use in practice
citations.what_it_says: Mixed-methods study: physiotherapists use MSK ultrasound to verify diagnoses, educate patients, and streamline care pathways.

citations.title: Diagnostic Services by Physical Therapists (Physician Fee Schedule guidance)
citations.what_it_says: CMS guidance: diagnostic ultrasound imaging codes are non-covered when performed by PTs under Medicare, limiting reimbursement to cash-pay and select private payers.

citations.title: RMSK for Physical Therapists - APTA/AIUM/Inteleos collaborative pathway
citations.what_it_says: Official credential pathway confirming PT eligibility for RMSK (valid license, 150 MSK studies in 36 months, 4-hour exam, $600 fee).
